skill.summary: 海南省建设工程造价指标专家技能。基于《2024年版海南省建设工程典型案例造价指标》，提供房屋建筑、市政工程等各类工程的造价指标查询、对比分析、投资估算等服务。触发词包括：海南造价指标、海南省造价、造价指标查询、投资估算、造价对比、建安造价、单方造价、经济指标、工程量指标。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the hainan-cost-index skill.

- Provides structured querying and analysis of Hainan Province construction cost indices, based on the 2024 edition of typical case cost indicators.
- Supports investment estimation, cost index lookups, comparative analysis, and structured reports for housing, municipal, public, and industrial projects.
- Includes reference tables for cost components, adjustment coefficients (region, time, fit-out), and standard output formats.
- Integrates official data from 23 typical construction case studies issued by Hainan authorities.
- Designed for professional scenarios such as feasibility study, audit, and budget planning.
